title: selfcheck's leftovers counts know only the verdicts remove and keep, so a tidy row with the verdict ask is missing from their total
goal: bl_selfcheck.leftovers counts the rows with the verdict ask beside remove and keep, so the leftovers line's total includes them, and kbmon's cleanup panel (mon_clean.py) shows how many rows wait for the operator's tidy --decide answer

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_selfcheck, inspect; assert 'bl_clean.ASK' in inspect.getsource(bl_selfcheck.leftovers)

notes: SP-ep7cyuob review (S3) widens this: bl_selfcheck.leftovers never applies bl_clean.answer_of, so an answered row still shows as ask in kbmon's cleanup panel and check_leftovers (which the cleanup session's prompt has Haiku read), and tidy --report (class_counts) counts ask rows as kept.
